contexts.text: The fifth state is that he speaks from faith, and thence confirms himself in what is true and good. The things he then produces are animate, and are called the fishes of the sea, and the birds of the heavens. AC 29.
Scientific and intellectual faith is represented from  by inanimate things, but faith vivified through love is represented from  by animate things.
Fishes = scientific things, here animated through faith by the Lord, and so made living.
The bones and flesh, which, during his life in the world, were not animated from themselves, but from the life of his spirit...
(Difference between man and the animated things of the earth.)
The quality of truths with those who live according to them, and with those who do not, shown... Thus the former were animate truths, but the latter inanimate.
The animate things of the earth in general correspond to good affections...

Man has for an end that which he loves above all things... it is in his will like the hidden current of a river which draws and carries away, even when he is doing something else, for this is what animates.
The word spirit derives its origin from animation...
5. Souls of life, and living souls, and vegetative souls are animated through uses and according to them by life that is from the Lord. General article.

By animation is meant not only that they live, but also that they are and exist. The reason why they are continually animated; that is, live, are, and exist from the Lord, is that when once creation has been perfected, it is continued through influx from the Sun of Heaven.
